Calls for proposals, grants, tenders and expressions of interest relevant to organisations working in Bangladesh. Every listing shows the funder, size, deadline and status, and links to the original notice.

Open now

Last checked: 7 November 2026.

Recently closed

How we list opportunities

  • We link to the funder’s own notice wherever one exists.
  • Status labels are OPEN, CLOSING SOON (seven days or less), UPCOMING and CLOSED. We never describe an expired call as open.
  • Each listing shows the date we last checked it. Deadlines can change, so always confirm with the funder.
  • Featured placement may be paid for in future. Paid listings will always be labelled and will never change a listing’s status or details.

Funding Tracker

We are building a tracker of who funds what in Bangladesh: major donors, thematic priorities, humanitarian and development financing, climate finance and localisation. Read our first funding analysis on the Rohingya response appeal and the changing aid landscape.
